behavioral_policy: Strict all-zero empty record admission is project policy; donor checks only byte0.
MOVE/UP without acknowledged DOWN is rejected; donor implicit MOVE-to-DOWN promotion is not reused.
Any Samsung error status or known ready/reset status invalidates logical stream; cancellation must be acknowledged. No controller reset is performed.
